headline: BRIXTON METALS Drills 13m at 594 G/T SILVER — Including 0.5m at 7,900 G/T at Cobalt Camp's Langis Project
snippet: Brixton Metals (TSX-V: BBB) posted one of its strongest intercepts to date at the historic Langis Silver Project in Cobalt, Ontario — 13.0m at 594 g/t silver including a bonanza 0.5m at 7,900 g/t. The company has completed 13,845m across 68 holes in 2026 and is adding a second rig mid-May to accelerate toward a maiden resource estimate.

headline: MITHRIL SILVER Drills 9.65m at 7 G/T Gold, 370 G/T Silver — Extends Copalquin Resource 300m West Ahead of June Update
snippet: Mithril Silver and Gold (TSX-V: MSG, ASX: MTH) intersected 9.65m at 7.00 g/t gold and 370 g/t silver at Target 1 of its Copalquin property in Durango, Mexico — approximately 300m west of the existing 2021 mineral resource boundary, including a 0.5m high-grade core of 30.7 g/t Au and 1,780 g/t Ag. Results support meaningful resource expansion ahead of a June 2026 estimate update.

headline: GOLIATH RESOURCES Adds 40-Year Mine-Builder to Advisory Board, Launches FULLY-FUNDED 50,000m Drill at Surebet
snippet: Goliath Resources (TSX-V: GOT) appointed Alan Edwards — 40+ years spanning open pit and underground gold operations globally — to its advisory board as mobilization begins for a fully-funded 50,000-meter 2026 drill program at the Surebet Gold Discovery in BC's Golden Triangle. The company drilled 64,364 meters with a 100% hit rate across 46 mineralized veins in 2025.

headline: OMAI GOLD Hits ALL-TIME TSX HIGH on Guyana Assays — 7.74 G/T Gold Over 13.5m at Wenot Deposit
snippet: Omai Gold Mines (TSX-V: OMG) shares hit a new all-time high after the company released multi-zone drill results at Wenot in Guyana, including 7.74 g/t Au over 13.5m, with five rigs now active and an additional hole planned to test the near-surface Gilt deposit for depth potential. The project hosts 8.0 million ounces at 1.7 g/t Au across indicated and inferred categories.

headline: CANEX METALS Acquires Gold Basin Resources at 242% PREMIUM — All-Share TSX-V Deal to Close June 2026
snippet: CANEX Metals (TSX-V: CANX) announced a plan of arrangement to absorb all remaining Gold Basin Resources (TSX-V: GXX) shares at a 242% premium to Gold Basin's last price prior to its cease-trade order, with a $900,000 bridge loan extended ahead of expected June 2026 close. The deal adds to ongoing junior gold sector consolidation driven by elevated gold prices.

headline: ARIZONA SONORAN Shareholders Back Hudbay Merger 99% — C$1.48B Copper Deal Heads to Court May 14
snippet: Arizona Sonoran Copper (TSX: ASCU) shareholders voted 99% in favour of Hudbay Minerals' C$1.48 billion takeover at a May 11 special meeting, with each shareholder receiving 0.242 Hudbay shares per ASCU share held. The deal awaits final court approval scheduled for May 14, after which Hudbay gains a major copper asset in Arizona's Battle Mountain district.

headline: BRAZIL REGULATOR Opens Antitrust Probe Into USA RARE EARTH's $2.8B Serra Verde Acquisition
snippet: Brazil's antitrust watchdog CADE opened proceedings on May 12 to assess USA Rare Earth's (Nasdaq: USAR) proposed $2.8 billion acquisition of Serra Verde Group — operator of Brazil's only rare earth mine in Goiás state — raising a regulatory hurdle for Washington's effort to build a Western rare earth supply chain outside Asia. A parallel court challenge also seeks to halt the sale.

headline: CANADA GROWTH FUND Backs Elevra's A$441M Package to EXPAND Canada's Largest Lithium Mine
snippet: Elevra Lithium unveiled a A$441 million ($437M USD) financing package on May 12 — including a C$145M Canada Growth Fund convertible note — to expand North American Lithium (NAL) in Quebec, Canada's largest operating lithium mine, with throughput rising to 338,000 t/y and an updated scoping study doubling the expansion NPV to $969 million.

headline: LI-FT POWER / WINSOME RESOURCES: WA Court Approves Lithium Merger — MAY 21 CLOSE CONFIRMED
snippet: The Supreme Court of Western Australia approved the share and option schemes on May 11 combining Li-FT Power (TSX-V: LIFT) with ASX-listed Winsome Resources, with implementation confirmed for on or around May 21, 2026. The deal creates a cross-listed lithium explorer with pegmatite assets in Canada's Northwest Territories and Australia.
